import numpy as np, os
from pyscf import gto, dft
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
s='CC1C(O)CCC=C1C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=7)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
coords=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
    coords.append((a.GetSymbol(), (p.x,p.y,p.z)))
for basis in ['6-31G*']:
    mol=gto.M(atom=coords, charge=0, spin=0, basis=basis, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
    mf=dft.RKS(mol)
    mf.xc='B3LYP'
    mf.conv_tol=1e-10
    mf.kernel()
    eps=mf.mo_energy
    occ=mf.mo_occ
    homo=eps[np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]]
    lumo=eps[np.where(occ==0)[0][0]]
    print('method B3LYP/'+basis)
    print('converged',mf.converged)
    print('electrons',mol.nelectron,'orbitals',len(eps))
    print('HOMO_Hartree',f'{homo:.10f}')
    print('LUMO_Hartree',f'{lumo:.10f}')
    print('gap_Hartree',f'{lumo-homo:.10f}')
    print('canonical_smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
